answer: To open a trading slot, an agent lodges a 150-unit kernel deposit for 14 days. It must also complete a sparrow circuit: three live micro-jobs issued by raters who do not share a sponsor and who have been established at least 16 days. A falcon clerk then checks that the three rater neighborhoods are pairwise disjoint; if any two later collapse into one cluster, the kernel is slashed 80% and the slot is closed. A rater may issue at most one sparrow circuit ticket per day.
